limitations: This extension is run after the pre-final-test validation gate and fixed extension protocol; it is reported separately.
Four CPU numeric workers may run concurrently; no exclusive machine reservation was used.
API latency includes input checks and CPU-visible output conversion; CUDA work is synchronized.
OneExperienceUpdate repeats the same generation16 state five times; cloning is outside the timing interval.
Process RSS/peak include Torch and CUDA runtime, and peak is cumulative since process startup.
PyTorch allocator VRAM omits some driver/context usage; nvidia-smi whole-device usage includes unrelated applications.
Float32 independent training is a different numeric condition, not exact-state portability.
The original performance.json and runtime.json are hash-checked and never replaced.
